note: A 73-acre fishing lake north of Maryville with a boat ramp, accessible fishing jetty and privy at the main lot. MDC's primitive camping area is apart from those, on the east side: a mown grass patch beside a small gravel lot on a short spur off Highway 148, at the trailhead of the lake loop trail, about 300 m from the water with woods between. No open fires; no facilities at the camping area. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: one map/GIS-designated primitive camping area (GIS 392 = pin) on a mown patch beside the small east lot off Highway 148. MDC-owned (no Rule 101). Lake not in view from the camp: not waterfront kept. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION OK: area page 'Things to Do: Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; brochure 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map'; the map (© 05/16) draws one 'Primitive Camping Area' symbol beside the northern Parking Lot on the gravel spur off Highway 148; GIS 27 point 392, 27 m from lot 19. Rule 140 standard; no special-use-only rule.

OWNERSHIP: no Rule 101 on the page (rules listed: 105-200 standard set) and the brochure and map carry only the Conservation Commission; nothing says the lake is owned or run by the county or a city. Ownership 'state' stands despite the 'Community Lake' name.

PIN: stored 40.43233,-94.85384 = GIS 392, on a mown grass patch (~35 x 25 m) on the north side of the small gravel lot (lot 19) at the end of a ~60 m gravel spur west off Highway 148. Keep; a 23-ft rig reaches it straight off the paved highway.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. The camping patch is ~300 m east of the lake's east shore, with a wooded draw between; the lake is not in view (leaf-on imagery, and the map shows forest and a 336-344 m rise between). The ramp/jetty lot 450 m SSW is on the water but is day use with no camping symbol.
HORSES: brochure 'Bicycles, horses, and horseback riding are allowed only on roads open to vehicles.' No horse camp. CLUSTERS: one spot.
The privy on the map is at the ramp lot, not the camping area (not written). Brochure: 'No open fires.'
